desc: Given an integer array nums, find the contiguous subarray (containing at least one number) with the largest sum, and return that sum.
hints: Checking every subarray is O(n²) at best.
At each position, decide: extend the previous subarray, or start fresh here.
Starting fresh is better exactly when the running sum so far is negative.
editorial: Let cur be the best sum of a subarray ending at the current index. Then cur = max(x, cur + x): either extend or restart. The answer is the maximum cur seen anywhere.
This is Kadane's algorithm, a one-line dynamic program. Initialise with the first element, not 0, so all-negative arrays work.
